recipes.title: Mon: Crock-Pot Beanless Keto Chili (N's request)
recipes.meta: Serves: 2 + leftovers (about 9 servings) · Active: 20 min · Total: 6–8 hr (low) · Net carbs/serving: ~7 g (estimate) · Protein/serving: ~32 g
ingredients: 1.5 lb leftover 80/20 ground beef (from last week) + 2 lb new (2 × 1 lb rolls) = 3.5 lb
½ bag (10 oz) frozen pepper & onion blend
2 celery ribs, diced
1 can (14.5 oz) diced tomatoes, with juice
1 can (15 oz) tomato sauce
2 packets (1 oz each) taco seasoning
1 tbsp chili powder (mild), 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp paprika (pantry)
1 tsp salt (taste at end), ½ cup water
To serve: taco blend cheese, sour cream, sliced avocado
steps: Morning: brown the beef in a large skillet over medium-high, 8–10 min, breaking it up. Drain most of the fat (keep ~2 tbsp).
Put beef, frozen peppers/onions (no need to thaw), celery, tomatoes, tomato sauce, taco seasoning, spices and water in the crock pot. Stir.
Cook on LOW 6–8 hr (or HIGH 3–4 hr). Stir, taste, adjust salt.
Serve topped with cheese, sour cream and avocado.
Refrigerate in 4–5 containers within 2 hr: about 2 servings for Wed chili bowls, 3–4 for lunches. Freeze any you won't eat by Thu.
notes: Cook early because the leftover ground beef has been in the fridge since last week (ground meat is the most perishable item). Check its date; if it smells off or is past the use-by, toss it and use only the 2 lb new (still plenty).
Beanless, so it stays keto. N's requested recipe.

recipes.title: Mon (prep): Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs & Broccoli (Big Batch)
recipes.meta: Makes about 10 servings · Active: 15 min · Total: 45 min · Net carbs/serving: ~2 g (estimate) · Protein/serving: ~30 g
ingredients: The whole family pack of chicken thighs left from last week (~5 lb)
2 tbsp EVOO, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika
½ bag (16 oz) frozen broccoli florets
1 tbsp butter
Dip: G Hughes yum yum sauce (your pick) or ranch
steps: Heat oven to 425°F, or use oven Air Fry mode at 400°F with the thighs on the tray (no basket).
Pat thighs dry; toss with EVOO and spices. Lay on 2 sheet pans, skin side up, not touching.
Bake 30–35 min (Air Fry mode 22–28 min) until 175°F inside and skin is crisp.
Last 15 min: add frozen broccoli to the open space on the pans; toss in the pan drippings.
Eat a few thighs with broccoli and butter tonight if you like; cool the rest, pull meat for Tue Cobb salad and lunches (4–5 containers). Freeze anything you won't eat by Thu.
notes: Cook early because the raw thighs have been in the fridge since last week. Cook them Monday (or freeze them tonight if they're near the use-by date).

recipes.title: Tue: Chicken Thigh Cobb Salad
recipes.meta: Serves: 2 · Active: 20 min · Net carbs/serving: ~6 g (estimate) · Protein/serving: ~45 g
ingredients: 1 lb pulled chicken thighs (from Monday)
6 slices bacon (half the pack)
4 hard-boiled eggs (from the eggs you have)
2 romaine hearts, chopped
1 avocado, diced
½ cup taco blend cheese
Ranch dressing (2 tbsp each)
steps: Bake bacon on a sheet pan at 400°F 15–18 min (or oven Air Fry mode 375°F 10–12 min) until crisp; crumble.
Warm the chicken in a skillet 3–4 min or eat it cold.
Arrange romaine, chicken, egg, avocado, bacon and cheese in rows; drizzle with ranch.
notes: Cook early because romaine and avocado are the most perishable produce; this uses them while fresh.

recipes.title: Wed: Chili Cheese Bowls over Cauliflower Rice
recipes.meta: Serves: 2 · Active: 15 min · Net carbs/serving: ~9 g (estimate) · Protein/serving: ~35 g
ingredients: 2–3 servings leftover chili
1 bag (12 oz) frozen riced cauliflower
1 tbsp butter, salt
Toppings: taco blend cheese, sour cream, salsa, ½ avocado
steps: Cook cauliflower rice in a dry skillet over medium-high 6–8 min, stirring, until steam is gone. Stir in butter and salt.
Reheat chili in a pot until bubbling (165°F).
Spoon chili over the rice; top with cheese, sour cream, salsa and avocado.
notes: Uses the chili while it's within 4 days of cooking.

recipes.title: Thu: Sheet-Pan Shrimp Fajitas
recipes.meta: Serves: 2 + 1 lunch · Active: 15 min · Total: 30 min · Net carbs/serving: ~8 g (estimate) · Protein/serving: ~35 g
ingredients: 1 lb frozen raw peeled shrimp (half the bag you have), thawed
1 bag (20 oz) frozen pepper & onion blend (your addition)
2 tbsp EVOO + 1 packet fajita seasoning
1 lime
Serve on: romaine leaves or Organic riced cauliflower (10 oz, your addition) cooked in a dry skillet
Toppings: sour cream, salsa, taco blend cheese, avocado
steps: Wed night: move 1 lb shrimp to the fridge to thaw (or thaw in cold water 10 min). Pat very dry.
Heat oven to 425°F. Toss frozen peppers/onions with 1 tbsp EVOO and half the seasoning; roast on a sheet pan 15 min.
Toss shrimp with 1 tbsp EVOO and the rest of the seasoning; add to the pan. Roast 6–8 min until pink and opaque. (Or oven Air Fry mode 400°F, 5–6 min for the shrimp.)
Squeeze lime over. Serve in romaine leaves or over cauliflower rice with toppings.
notes: Frozen shrimp and peppers keep, so this sits later in the week.

recipes.title: Fri: Garlic-Butter Shrimp with Spinach
recipes.meta: Serves: 2 · Active: 20 min · Net carbs/serving: ~5 g (estimate) · Protein/serving: ~40 g
ingredients: 1 lb frozen raw peeled shrimp (the rest of the bag), thawed, patted very dry
1 box (10 oz) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed very dry
2 tbsp butter + 1 tbsp EVOO
1½ tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp paprika, salt, pepper
½ cup half & half, ¼ cup taco blend cheese
1 tbsp coconut aminos (your addition, optional), juice of ½ lime
steps: Skillet, medium-high: EVOO + 1 tbsp butter. Add shrimp in one layer, season with salt, pepper, paprika and ½ tsp garlic powder; 2 min per side. Remove.
Same pan: 1 tbsp butter, spinach and the rest of the garlic powder, 2 min. Add half & half and cheese; simmer 2–3 min until creamy.
Return shrimp; add coconut aminos and lime. Toss 1 min.
notes: Frozen shrimp and spinach: fine late in the week.

recipes.title: Sat: Buffalo Chicken Bake
recipes.meta: Serves: 2 + 2 lunches · Active: 15 min · Total: 40 min · Net carbs/serving: ~5 g (estimate) · Protein/serving: ~40 g
ingredients: 3 cans (12.5 oz) chunk chicken breast, drained (your addition; keep 1 can for a lunch)
1 brick (8 oz) cream cheese, softened
⅓ cup Frank's RedHot, ¼ cup ranch
1 cup taco blend cheese
Rest of the bag (16 oz) frozen broccoli florets, thawed and patted dry
2 celery ribs, sliced thin
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. In a 9×13 dish, stir cream cheese, hot sauce and ranch until smooth.
Fold in chicken, broccoli and celery. Top with cheese.
Bake 20–25 min until bubbly and lightly browned (165°F). Rest 5 min.
Serve with celery sticks. Refrigerate leftovers for lunches (good cold or warm).
notes: Canned chicken and frozen broccoli keep, so this is late in the week.

recipes.title: Sun: Bacon, Spinach & Cheese Crustless Quiche
recipes.meta: Serves: 2 + 2 breakfasts · Active: 15 min · Total: 50 min · Net carbs/serving: ~3 g (estimate) · Protein/serving: ~28 g
ingredients: 10 eggs (from the eggs you have)
1 cup half & half
6 slices bacon (rest of the pack)
1 box (10 oz) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed very dry
1 cup taco blend cheese
½ tsp salt, ¼ tsp pepper, ½ tsp garlic powder, butter for the dish
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Butter a 9-inch pie dish or 8×8 pan.
Cook bacon (sheet pan 400°F 15 min); crumble.
Whisk eggs, half & half, salt, pepper and garlic powder. Stir in spinach, bacon and cheese. Pour into the dish.
Bake 35–40 min until the center is just set (160°F). Rest 10 min. Serve with Oikos or a side salad.
notes: Eggs, frozen spinach and cured bacon keep well, so this is last. Leftovers make Mon/Tue breakfasts.

recipes.title: Treat: Cheesecake Fluff
recipes.meta: Makes 4 servings · 10 min · Net carbs/serving: ~4 g (estimate)
ingredients: 1 brick (8 oz) cream cheese, softened
2 cups Oikos Triple Zero Vanilla (from what you have)
2–3 tbsp Swerve confectioners (erythritol), to taste
Pinch of cinnamon
steps: Beat cream cheese until smooth.
Beat in yogurt and Swerve until fluffy. Dust with cinnamon.
Chill 30 min. Keeps 4 days covered.
notes: One of this week's 2 sweet treats. Keep it modest: ½ cup a serving.

recipes.title: Treat: Cinnamon "Churro" Pork Rinds
ingredients: 2 oz pork rinds (Original)
1 tbsp butter, melted
1 tbsp Swerve confectioners + ½ tsp cinnamon
steps: Toss pork rinds with melted butter on a sheet pan.
Shake the Swerve-cinnamon mix over and toss.
Oven Air Fry mode 350°F 2–3 min on the tray (no basket) to set the coating. Eat warm.
notes: Second sweet treat for the week.

prep: Mon morning: brown beef and start the crock-pot chili (recipe p.1).
Mon evening: sheet-pan the whole pack of chicken thighs (p.2); pull and portion meat for Tue Cobb salad and 4–5 lunches.
Hard-boil 12 eggs (you have eggs): boil, then 12 min covered off heat, ice bath. 4 for Tue Cobb, rest for lunches and snacks.
Wash, dry and chop romaine; store with a paper towel in a bag. Keep a few leaves whole for fajita wraps.
Cut celery into sticks; store in a jar of water.
Portion almonds (¼ cup) and string cheese into grab bags; pack small ranch cups.
Leftover cooked carnitas pork: eat as a lunch Mon (it's at its 4–5 day limit); toss or freeze anything left.
Wed night: move 1 lb shrimp to the fridge for Thu; Thu night move the other 1 lb for Fri.
Pack cooler: 2 ice packs, containers, napkins. Keep cooler cold (below 40°F); eat lunch within 4–5 hr of packing.
